description: Rank ERCOT settlement points for storage, solar and generation over the last N days using day-ahead prices. Battery metrics: TB2 and TB4 (average daily top-minus-bottom 2-hour and 4-hour spreads, the standard arbitrage metric), annualized TB4 revenue per MW, hourly standard deviation, coefficient of variation, daily range, hours over $100, negative hours, evening peak (HE 17-21) average. Solar metrics: solar capture price (node average over HE 9-18), capture ratio, negative solar hours. Real-time: RT TB4, RT spikes and DART (day-ahead minus real-time). 15-minute real-time: rt15_tb4 (TB4 at 15-min resolution, capturing intra-hour spikes hourly averages wash out), rt15_spikes (15-min intervals over $100), rt15_over_1000, rt15_negative. Basis: node average minus its load zone average (generators are paid the node price, load pays the zone price). Every response also carries the system-wide ancillary service stack (RegUp/RRS/ECRS clearing prices, annualized per MW) for the same window. Filter to a load zone, or to nodes within a radius of an address or coordinate. Use when someone asks where a battery would make the most money, which nodes are most volatile, which nodes pay solar best, where prices spike or go negative, where congestion traps prices, or how a site compares. Default: top 20 resource nodes statewide by TB4 over 30 days.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

days.description: Window in days. Default 30. Max 30 free, 120 Pro.

include_zones_and_hubs.description: Also rank load zones and hubs alongside resource nodes. Default false.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Default 20, max 50 (10 on the free tier).

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

load_zone.description: Restrict to a load zone: LZ_HOUSTON, LZ_NORTH, LZ_SOUTH, LZ_WEST, LZ_AEN, LZ_CPS, LZ_LCRA, LZ_RAYBN.

metric.description: Ranking metric. Default tb4. solar = best-paid solar nodes, basis = node minus zone, evening = post-sunset discharge value, rt_tb4 = real-time 4-hour spread, rt_spikes = real-time hours over $100, dart = day-ahead minus real-time, rt15_tb4 = 15-minute real-time TB4 (captures intra-hour spikes), rt15_spikes = 15-minute intervals over $100.

radius_mi.description: With a location: only nodes within this many miles. Default 50, max 150.

name: volatile_nodes
title: Most volatile ERCOT nodes for battery storage
